title: Product of array except self
q: Return a list where element i is the product of every number except nums[i]. Do not use division.
ref:
def product_except_self(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    out = [1] * n
    left = 1
    for i in range(n):
        out[i] = left
        left *= nums[i]
    right = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        out[i] *= right
        right *= nums[i]
    return out
hints: Product of everything to the left of i times everything to the right.

def rotate(nums, k):
    n = len(nums)
    k %= n
    nums.reverse()
    nums[:k] = reversed(nums[:k])
    nums[k:] = reversed(nums[k:])

def max_sum_k(nums, k):
    window = sum(nums[:k])
    best = window
    for i in range(k, len(nums)):
        window += nums[i] - nums[i - k]
        best = max(best, window)
    return best

def reverse_list(head):
    prev = None
    while head:
        nxt = head.next
        head.next = prev
        prev = head
        head = nxt
    return prev

title: Palindrome linked list
q: Return True if the values of the list read the same forwards and backwards. Try O(1) extra space.
ref:
def is_palindrome_ll(head):
    slow = fast = head
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow = slow.next
        fast = fast.next.next
    prev = None
    while slow:
        nxt = slow.next
        slow.next = prev
        prev = slow
        slow = nxt
    a, b = head, prev
    while b:
        if a.val != b.val:
            return False
        a, b = a.next, b.next
    return True

ref:
def subsets(nums):
    out = []
    def go(i, cur):
        if i == len(nums):
            out.append(cur[:])
            return
        cur.append(nums[i])
        go(i + 1, cur)
        cur.pop()
        go(i + 1, cur)
    go(0, [])
    return out

def max_product(nums):
    hi = lo = best = nums[0]

        hi, lo = max(cands), min(cands)
        best = max(best, hi)

title: Insert interval

ref:
def insert(intervals, new_interval):
    out = []
    s, e = new_interval
    i = 0
    while i < len(intervals) and intervals[i][1] < s:
        out.append(intervals[i])
        i += 1
    while i < len(intervals) and intervals[i][0] <= e:
        s = min(s, intervals[i][0])
        e = max(e, intervals[i][1])
        i += 1
    out.append([s, e])
    out.extend(intervals[i:])
    return out

title: Meeting rooms II

ref:
def min_meeting_rooms(intervals):
    starts = sorted(s for s, e in intervals)
    ends = sorted(e for s, e in intervals)
    rooms = best = j = 0
    for s in starts:
        while ends[j] <= s:
            j += 1
            rooms -= 1
        rooms += 1
        best = max(best, rooms)
    return best

title: Running median
q: Numbers arrive one at a time. After each arrival, report the median so far. Return the list of medians.
ref:
def running_median(stream):
    import heapq
    lo, hi = [], []
    out = []
    for x in stream:
        heapq.heappush(lo, -x)
        heapq.heappush(hi, -heapq.heappop(lo))
        if len(hi) > len(lo):
            heapq.heappush(lo, -heapq.heappop(hi))
        out.append(float(-lo[0]) if len(lo) > len(hi) else (-lo[0] + hi[0]) / 2)
    return out

title: Course schedule
q: There are n courses 0..n-1. prereqs has pairs [a, b] meaning you must take b before a. Return True if all courses can be finished.
ref:
def can_finish(n, prereqs):
    from collections import deque
    graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    indeg = [0] * n
    for a, b in prereqs:
        graph[b].append(a)
        indeg[a] += 1
    q = deque(i for i in range(n) if indeg[i] == 0)
    done = 0
    while q:
        x = q.popleft()
        done += 1
        for y in graph[x]:
            indeg[y] -= 1
            if indeg[y] == 0:
                q.append(y)
    return done == n

title: Largest rectangle in histogram

ref:
def largest_rectangle(heights):
    stack = []
    best = 0
    for i, h in enumerate(heights + [0]):
        start = i
        while stack and stack[-1][1] >= h:
            idx, height = stack.pop()
            best = max(best, height * (i - idx))
            start = idx
        stack.append((start, h))
    return best
